Case Studies Roadmap

Planning page — building a structured B2B case library

Status: roadmap (ZH/EN aligned) · This page becomes a case list once real project assets arrive.

Required structure per case

  1. Cover image (≥1200px)
  2. Customer & industry (may be anonymized)
  3. Challenge — range, response, reliability, size constraints
  4. Solution — sensor + controller + interface
  5. Delivery milestones — sample → calibration → pilot → volume
  6. Results — ≥2 quantified metrics
  7. CTA to product detail + inquiry form

Optimization notes

  • Ship one complete flagship case before adding more stubs.
  • EN can be a Challenge / Solution / Results abstract linking to the Chinese full write-up.
  • No publish without ≥2 quantified results and asset rights clearance.
  • Cross-link every case to its SKU; add “Related cases” on product pages once live.
